stories.title: Carrick delivers 5min 27sec monologue and says he will hold brolly to keep everyone dry

stories.title: World and Olympic marathon champion Jepchirchir suspended after positive doping test
summary: AIU investigates after sample tested positive for EPO33-year-old won Olympic marathon in 2021In a fresh blow for Kenyan athletics, the women’s world marathon champion, Peres Jepchirchir, has been provisionally suspended for doping, the Athletics Integrity Unit (AIU) announced on Friday.The highly decorated 33-year-old, who won Olympic gold in the Covid-delayed Tokyo Games in 2021, was suspended after an out-of-competition sample tested positive for the banned blood booster EPO.
